messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up — Sunrise Payments onboarding demo tomorrow needs EU peering + a short traffic lift. They asked for three items: enable EU egress peering, add a couple CIDR/IPs to a temporary access set, and a provisional rate-window bump for the demo. cc @sara_account @oliver_infra

oliver_infra: Thanks — can you confirm exact demo window (UTC) and whether this is for Hosted API or Dedicated capacity? Also need TTL for the temporary rules.

dan_engineering: Also need expected tokens/sec and the model they’ll hit (so we can recommend batching/kv cache tweak). If it’s redwood-large-v2 we should pre-warm cache.

maya_cs: Hosted API. Demo window: 2025-05-14 14:00-17:00 UTC. Model: redwood-large-v2 (default generation). Expected peak ~9k qps for short bursts, avg ~2.5k. TTL: please auto-revoke rules 24h after window end.

oliver_infra: Ok — we can create a temporary peering/egress rule and a short-lived IP/CIDR grant. Please confirm IPs: 34.210.12.0/24 and 18.197.33.5? We’ll tag the rule sunrise-demo-5765 and set expiry 2025-05-15T17:00:00Z.

maya_cs: Correct on the two CIDRs. Tag/name fine. Important: this must be a scoped burst window, not a global quota change. Auto-revoke required.

dan_engineering: For the throughput bump, we’ll set a provisional rate-window policy: target 12k qps (burstable to 15k) for 14:00-17:00 UTC. Suggest enabling aggressive KV caching and a 0.5s batching target for that window. Also recommend using the quantization profile q-prof-1 to keep memory small during demo.

sara_account: Flagging renewal here — Sunrise’s annual renewal is in ~30 days. They’re treating this demo as a make-or-break. Would recommend following up with a short post-demo success metrics doc and offering a trial Dedicated discount to reduce renewal friction. I can join the demo if helpful.

relay-bot: Ticket created: INC-5421 — "Sunrise Payments EU demo peering + temp rate window" — https://redwood.internal/INC-5421

oliver_infra: Network ticket queued. I’ll apply the peering and temp allow rules after config review. Will add an expiry and autoclose workflow. ETA to have rules ready: 2025-05-14 12:30 UTC.

dan_engineering: I’ll pre-warm the model and stage the cache. Quick command to pre-warm (example):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v2","prompt":"prewarm ping","max_tokens":1,"n":10}'
```

maya_cs: Perfect — can you also confirm the log hooks so we capture latency and error-rate for the post-demo recap? Need token-level cost estimate too.

dan_engineering: Will enable per-route tracing and export telemetry to the demo workspace. I’ll attach a small cost projection to INC-5421.

oliver_infra: Note: this is temporary and scoped. No permanent quota updates. Policy will auto-revoke and I’ll post the rule id once created. :thumbsup:

sara_account: Thanks team — I’ll prep a one-page renewal playbook and coordinate follow-up emails to the customer after the demo. Maya, please confirm customer contact + headcount for the session.

maya_cs: Customer contact is lucy@sunrisepayments.com, attendees: 6 (2 product, 2 infra, 2 exec). I’ll confirm and update INC-5421. Thanks everyone, will close loop after customer confirms. :pray:
